title: Heart
description: A hollow, inflated heart balloon, drawn from the tip upward.

title: Ring
description: A pavé diamond ring: band and pavé stones, head prongs, then the main stone filling in.

title: Wine glass
description: A faceted wine glass with red wine: foot and stem first, then the bowl, then the wine.

title: Hourglass
description: An hourglass from a mesh: plates and posts, see-through glass bulbs and sand filling in last.

title: Möbius band
description: A Möbius band: a wide ribbon that twists once, so the loop has a single side.

title: Trefoil knot
description: A trefoil knot: one thick tube that crosses itself three times.

title: DNA
description: A DNA double helix: two strands wind up, joined by base pairs.

title: Nautilus
description: A nautilus shell: a ribbed tube that grows by a fixed factor each turn.

title: Planet
description: A ringed planet with a moon: banded globe, two rings and a gap between them.

title: Crown
description: A crown with five points, a rim ring and a jewel on every point.

title: Key
description: An old key: round bow, collared shaft and a toothed bit.

title: Can
description: A cola can: body rising from the base, then the rim and tab.

title: Beer bottle
description: A green beer bottle: glass rises, the beer fills in, the plug closes it.

title: Wine bottle
description: A wine bottle: glass rises, the wine fills in, the capsule closes it.
